about: Copied on 2026-11-22 from the Poiesis Lab notebook's fixtures, with only the fields the stamp test reads. `challenger` is the verdict the challenger gave each conclusion on 2026-11-17 (challenge-verdicts.json, ids in lower case). `published` and `corrected` are the rows of trend-scan/challenge.published.json and challenge.corrected.json: the id, the verdict shown on the page, and the restated claim. The published file shows c6 as kept; the challenger said weakened.

published.restated: Raw counts overstate 2025 growth by about 18 points, not 29.
Synthetic biology accelerated in 2025. One year, so a lead to watch.
Largest and fastest-growing; the real break was around 2017.
Still growing, more slowly. No decline.
Fast and steady, slowing more than the broad numbers show.
Slow growth, no detectable change in rate.
